name: Circular Quay West: the Park Hyatt, the passenger terminal, Campbell's Stores and the ASN Co building

buildings.why: The Park Hyatt at Campbells Cove: four storeys in pale render curving round the cove under a flat grey roof (dominic-kurniawan-suryaputra, caleb). The map had it in red brick.
The Overseas Passenger Terminal on its wharf: two tall storeys over the wharf, its roof about level with the Park Hyatt's (dominic-kurniawan-suryaputra, caleb, dan-freeman). The map had 4 m.
Campbell's Stores on Campbells Cove: three storeys of red-brick bond stores under a row of slate gables along the water (dominic-kurniawan-suryaputra). The map had a flat roof at 7 m.
The ASN Co building on Hickson Rd: red brick under gables, five storeys from the quay with its clock tower over them (dominic-kurniawan-suryaputra). The map had a flat roof.
